verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents named virtual accounts, per-customer virtual IBANs, or dedicated deposit addresses that attribute incoming funds to a specific customer. The enterprise page mentions accepting bank transfers and auto-converting incoming fiat to stablecoins, but it says nothing about per-customer attribution or reconciliation. That is an adjacent capability, not this story's.

support.subject: As a developer, incoming funds are attributable — named virtual accounts or dedicated deposit addresses per customer so reconciliation knows who paid without manual matching
